verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party natural-language interface, such as a built-in assistant or chat command layer, for operating Square. The official MCP server and llms.txt let external AI agents reach Square's APIs, but the language understanding happens in the third-party agent. That evidence belongs to a separate MCP/agent-integration story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
